articles.title: Avó vai pela primeira vez ao campo de futebol para apoiar neto em jogo: 'O sonho dele é nosso' | G1
articles.standfirst: Iniciativa de inclusão pelo esporte reúne adolescentes da capital e do interior e abre caminho para a descoberta de novos talentos.
articles.summary: Iniciativa de inclusão pelo esporte reúne adolescentes da capital e do interior e abre caminho para a descoberta de novos talentos.
articles.body:
Jogador de futebol mirim, Igor Rafael, ao lado da avó, Úrsula da Silva Lima — Foto: Tiago Côrtes/ g1RR

"Meu sonho é ser jogador de futebol profissional" , disse Igor Rafael, de 11 anos. Ele é de Rorainópolis , ao Sul de Roraima, mas esteve em Boa Vista para disputar a final do 1º Torneio Jornada de Talentos. O evento aconteceu neste sábado (31), no Centro de Treinamento (CT) do Monte Roraima Futebol Clube.

Úrsula da Silva Lima, avó de Igor, mora em Caracaraí . Ela contou que não gosta de futebol, mas foi acompanhar o neto nesse momento, que considerou importante para o sonho dele de ser jogador profissional de futebol.

"Só vim porque eu gosto de ver ele [o neto] jogar. Para mim, é a primeira vez que eu tô vindo ver ele jogar e eu até me emocionei quando cheguei aqui. Ele sempre gostou e sempre quis. Ele até diz pra gente que jogar fora do município onde ele mora, pra ele é um sonho. O sonho dele sendo realizado, o nosso também tá sendo junto com ele", contou.

O Projeto Jornada de Talentos atende mais de 2 mil jovens de 11 a 17 anos em 14 núcleos espalhados por Boa Vista e municípios do interior de Roraima. A iniciativa utiliza o futebol como ferramenta de inclusão social, formação cidadã e identificação de novos talentos.

Branco , considerado um dos heróis do tetracampeonato da Seleção Brasileira, é coordenador das categorias de base da CBF. Ele esteve no evento e destacou a importância da formação de base para o desenvolvimento do futebol brasileiro .

"O trabalho de base é fundamental e a grande salvação de todos os clubes. O Brasil é um celeiro de craques. Esse projeto de vocês [o Jornada de Talentos] é espetacular. O Monte Roraima tem uma estrutura que tem tudo para fomentar o futebol brasileiro", afirmou.

O presidente da Confederação Brasileira de Futebol (CBF), Samir Xaud, também marcou presença no torneio e analisou que a ampliação do futebol de base em Roraima pode revelar novos talentos para o cenário nacional.

"Eu não tenho dúvida do potencial do futebol roraimense, desses jovens, das crianças. Com um projeto como esse, estendendo para todo o estado de Roraima, não tenho dúvida que surgirão vários craques para o mundo todo", declarou.

Branco, Nicoletti e Samir Xaud — Foto: Tiago Côrtes/ g1rr

A etapa final do torneio reúne equipes campeãs das fases regionais realizadas no interior do estado. Durante as partidas, os atletas foram observados pela comissão técnica do Monte Roraima e por avaliadores da CBF.

Segundo o senador eleito Nicoletti (PL), um dos idealizadores do projeto Jornada de Talentos e sócio do Monte Roraima, o objetivo é ampliar o acesso ao esporte para atletas que vivem longe dos grandes centros.

"O principal objetivo que a gente tem hoje é isso: realmente buscar os atletas no interior, das comunidades indígenas, trazer para a cidade e daí a gente poder seguir com o sonho desses atletas", afirmou.

O clube mantém quatro núcleos na capital, nos bairros Pérola e União, além de dois no Campo do Salada, no bairro Pricumã. Há ainda unidades em municípios como Alto Alegre , Cantá e Caracaraí, além da comunidade indígena Napoleão, em Normandia .

"Pra mim é a primeira vez que eu tô vindo ver ele jogar."Na Toca do Tamanduá, como é chamado o Centro de Treinamento do Monte Roraima, os atletas selecionados recebem apoio educacional, acompanhamento psicológico, alojamento e alimentação.

articles.title: Zakharyan no está en una lista para el derbi con todos los importantes para Matarazzo
articles.standfirst: El ruso no está disponible para la visita al Athletic, como anticipó ayer el técnico de Nueva Jersey, que podrá disponer de todos sus futbolistas más relevantes
articles.summary: El ruso no está disponible para la visita al Athletic, como anticipó ayer el técnico de Nueva Jersey, que podrá disponer de todos sus futbolistas más relevantes
articles.body: La ausencia de Arsen Zakharyan, anticipada ayer por Pellegrino Matarazzo, es la única novedad con la que la Real Sociedad visitará mañana al Athletic en San Mamés, después de conocerse ya la convocatoria oficial que ha realizado Pellegrino Matarazzo. El centrocampista ruso apenas estaba entrando en los planes del técnico, por lo que su baja no supone un contratiempo importante. Zakharyan no estaba entrando en las rotaciones habituales de Matarazzo, pero aún así hay alguna duda respecto al once que pueda presentar mañana. Remiro, y la defensa, con Aramburu, Jon Martín, Sarr y Sergio Gómez, aparentan ser las líneas más claras. Gorrotxategi parece haber adelantado a Herrera, con Soler y Turrientes jugándose acompañarle, pero sin poner la mano en el fuego por ninguno. Y en ataque Oyarzabal y Guedes serían fijos, con Sucic, Barrenetxea y Kubo optando a las otras dos plazas, porque Óskarsson parece que esta vez estará de inicio en el banquillo. La lista de convocados para el derbi de mañana en Billbao la componen los porteros Remiro, Marrero y Fraga, y los jugadores de campo Aramburu, Aihen, Gorrotxategi, Zubeldia, Jon Martín, Barrenetxea, Turrientes, Óskarsson, Oyarzabal, Guedes, Ochieng, Kubo, Marín, Pacheco, Sergio Gómez, Soler, Sarr, Herrera, Fort y Sucic.

articles.title: Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd: Lisandro Martinez sees red as Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer pile pressure on Michael Carrick
articles.summary: Match report as Cole Palmer's penalty and Morgan Rogers' solo goal condemn Man Utd to a 2-0 loss to Chelsea; Lisandro Martinez was sent off during a second-half collapse which leaves head coach Michael Carrick's future in doubt
articles.body:
The defeat extends United's winless run to nine games in all competitions, making it their longest since 1984, and puts them at risk of falling into the relegation zone this weekend.

Martinez, making only his second start since criticising the club's hierarchy, was shown a second yellow for raising an arm to the face of Wesley Fofana inside the United box following a VAR check, only three minutes after being booked for fouling Morgan Rogers.

Cole Palmer dispatched the resulting penalty, doubling Chelsea's lead after Rogers had charged through Manchester United's static defence and lifted a delicate finish over Senne Lammens for the opener at the start of the second half.

United's second-half implosion piles pressure on head coach Carrick, who reinstated Bruno Fernandes after dropping the captain for his criticism of his tactics after the defeat to Como.

Fernandes' return to the side, after he was an unused substitute in the 3-0 loss to Bournemouth , appeared to help United in the first half but they were unable to convert a series of chances.

Fernandes missed the best of them, firing harmlessly over when unmarked from Bryan Mbeumo's centre. Amad Diallo was also culpable as he was twice denied by Mike Penders as Chelsea struggled to contain United's counter-attacks.

But the visitors were made to pay for their wastefulness only five minutes after the interval, as Rogers accelerated into the box unchallenged to strike the first blow in a defeat which leaves United a point above the relegation zone, with Carrick's future in doubt.

Despite the result, the former midfielder received another positive reception from the away fans after the game. The players, booed off against Bournemouth, were also received more positively.

The scoreline could have been worse for United, though, with the excellent Estevao having a third goal ruled out by VAR for offside before drawing a full-stretch save from Lammens. But two goals were sufficient for the Blues to move above Liverpool into fourth.

Martinez pointed the finger at technical director Jason Wilcox and the club's decision-makers in his outspoken interview after the Atletico Madrid game . But he only had himself to blame for the events that led to his sending-off and Chelsea's penalty.

There were barely three minutes between his foul on Rogers that earned him his first yellow card and the confirmation, from referee Peter Bankes, that he would be receiving a second for needlessly raising an arm to the face of Fofana.

The defender, starting for the first time since the 1-1 draw against Leeds, was also one of the players at fault for Chelsea's opener, when Rogers glided through United's defence with bewildering ease to set the wheels in motion for United's defeat.

Martinez was not acknowledged by Carrick as he trudged down the tunnel. But the United head coach did not criticise him after the game, albeit while acknowledging the double whammy of having him sent off, and conceding a penalty, was a "big moment" in the game.

It was also a moment to sum up the dysfunction at the club.

Man Utd head coach Michael Carrick to TNT Sports :

"We didn't get going second half. We should've been up in the first half. Everything was as positive as we could've hoped for. We looked really dangerous.

"We found a way of unravelling in the second half. Bad goal to concede and then the penalty, we're right up against it. The game turned on its head.

"I don't think our heads dropped. The boys were in a good place first half. You could see that with the performance in the first half.

"It just gave them a lift. We didn't start the second half great. They struck the first blow and that made the difference."

Manchester United are winless in their last nine games in all competitions (D3 L6). They last had a longer run in September 1984 (10 games).

United have failed to win any of their first seven away games in all competitions in a season for the first time since 1973/74, when they were last relegated.

United haven't kept a single clean sheet in their first nine Premier League games of the season.

Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso to TNT Sports :

"We are happy. The game had different moments. The first half was close; few chances for both teams.

"At half-time we spoke about keeping control and said we will win the game if we keep the ball. It was a mature performance.

"I am very demanding. We can do better. We are taking a step forward but I don't know how far we are.

My expectations are really high. I am sure for the last three months of the season we will be much better."

On Estevao: "Estevao did really well. I am happy for him. He deserved this chance and the opportunity to give back.

"Absolutely, [his performance] has given him more reasons to say, 'Coach I want to play more minutes'."

Chelsea won a Premier League home game without conceding for the first time in 13 matches, since a 2-0 victory against Brentford in January.

Chelsea have kept two clean sheets in their last three Premier League games - one more than in their previous 28 matches in the competition.

Morgan Rogers became just the second Premier League player to reach 10 goal involvements in all competitions this season (6 goals, 4 assists), after Erling Haaland (13).

With an average age of 23 years and 89 days, Chelsea named their joint-second youngest starting line-up in a Premier League match (also 23y 89d against Newcastle in October 2024). Only against Crystal Palace in December 2023 have they had a younger one (23y 21d).

Cole Palmer scored his 50th Premier League goal for Chelsea; in his 105th appearance, he's the third-fastest to reach the milestone for the Blues after Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink (84) and Diego Costa (85).

articles.title: Brentford 2-0 Nottingham Forest: Oliver Glasner's side put in another concerning performance in attack as Bees win
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights as Brentford beat Nottingham Forest 2-0 in west London; Dango Ouatarra forced an own goal off Nikola Milenkovic to give the Bees a half-time lead; Igor Thiago sealed the points late on with a much-needed goal; Forest remain the lowest scorers in the league
articles.body:
"What the f******* hell was that?" sang the away fans as Brentford did not need to be particularly good to overcome Oliver Glasner's side and keep track with the Champions League places.

That anger was shared by Glasner himself in his post-match press conference, the head coach acknowledging things must change or Forest will be searching for their sixth manager since the start of last season.

"We have to accept it's not good enough," said the Austrian. "That's why it's for me, now time to change things."

Asked what those things are, Glasner replied: "Everywhere. And I feel I could see a few things from day No 1. I feel now that maybe I made too many compromises in some stuff. It's a clear way, I will tell what we want to do, what we have to do. And if the players buy in, we can have a turnaround. If not, the sixth manager will come in."

Nikola Milenkovic's own goal after good work from Dango Ouattara gave the Bees the lead - but there were no shots on target until the 76th minute, when Igor Thiago doubled the lead via a deflected strike.

That was partly due to Forest's poor finishing. They had two golden chances to score, one in each half: James McAtee curled wide from inside the box after being given time and space to get there, before half-time substitute Ryan Yates headed over from four yards out.

Forest remain the lowest scorers in the Premier League this season with only six so far - and they wasted 14 shots before finally getting one on target in the 79th minute, a pea roller from McAtee that Caoimhin Kelleher gratefully collected.

Scoring and creating meaningful chances remains a concern for Glasner's Forest, who remain in the bottom three.

4: CHANCE! Mamadou Sangare volleys wide for Brentford after a corner was cleared to his path.

20: ANOTHER! Thiago is played into a good area but drags a shot wide of goal.

24: HUGE CHANCE! McAtee goes on a solo run into the Brentford penalty area but curls wide from inside the box.

30: GOAL ! Ouattara is released from Caoimhin Kelleher's long-range ball and his cross is diverted into the box by Milenkovic.

38: OFF THE BAR! Mathias Jensen curls a free-kick which cannons off the top of the crossbar.

54: BIG MISS! Morgan Gibbs-White crosses for Yates who cannot convert from four yards out.

76: GOAL ! Thiago makes it 2-0 after being set up by substitute Jaidon Anthony.

Does Glasner blame players for performance?

Nottingham Forest head coach Oliver Glasner:

"No, they tried again. You can't say they had a lack of effort. But again, you feel you're controlling the game, you create a few good situations, and all of a sudden they're 1-0 down. It was the fourth goal we conceded from a long ball from a goalkeeper, so it's lack of awareness losing the duel, and we're 1-0 down.

"Then the players tried and tried. I think in the first 20 minutes in the second half, we just played in their half. Then I could see they're getting nervous. We're crossing and crossing and this and this.

"But again, if you always make some mistakes, or the same mistakes in defence that you've done, if in too many games you're not able to convert the chances you have, then we have to admit right now it's not good enough.

"For me, I don't want to talk about statistics and about whatever, because the reality is we didn't score a goal, we conceded two, we had enough set pieces, we didn't score again from a set piece, and it's not to blame. I take responsibility for everything. That's why I said, and I always take responsibility for the things I decided.

"I decided everything. It's just one person to blame, and that's me. That's why I say I can't and I won't continue in the same way as Oliver Glasner. I will change things. That's so clear for me, because otherwise, again, it's the same. You asked the fifth manager, I think you're asking the same question [that you gave to the other four].

"I think the performances are better than the ones [the other four] have been, but it's the same. And if things won't change, you will ask the sixth [manager to come in]."

Sherwood: Buck stops with Glasner and Marinakis won't hang about

Analysis fom Tim Sherwood on Soccer Saturday:

"They're not good enough, he's right about that. He's very honest with his appraisal of his side. They are not good enough [but] he's got to get on with it. There is nothing he can do until January. He ain't ging to be there in January

"They will lose next week against Manchester City and he'll get sacked in that international break. They will be on their next manager. Look at the history of this football club, they change managers.

"Marinakis, I quite admire his stance, Marinakis. He gives someone an opportunity - okay people might say he does not give him long enough - but he pulled that club from where they've been to the Premier League and he's made changes along the way.

"He doesn't suffer fools. He will not have anyone speak out against his football club. And I quite like it, he doesn't sit on his hands and wait, he just makes decisions and he will go and get another manager. He's probably saying we spent the money, we brought some new players into the football club, some of them you knew all about and you're not getting the best out of them.

"The buck stops with the manager and they can't change personnel at the moment they need to find someone who can get the best out of them and the position that they find themselves in, in the league, is not good enough."

Andrews: That was Brentford's best win of the season

"It's probably our best win of the season because you've got to show different traits to some of the other games.

"I think the schedule this week, for a start, hasn't been favourable to us. That's two cup rounds in a row where we've had the most condensed week out of anybody.

"Two difficult away trips and we didn't get the result we wanted to [against Sunderland], so there's that element to it as well.

"And then the opposition and how they play, how they try to set up and condense the pitch. It's pragmatic at times, they test you in different ways. They've got some very talented players that you have to keep quiet and you have to keep your concentration and focus.

"There was also some smart play today and leadership on show from our players that I really, really liked. On so many levels, I think it's a brilliant win."

articles.title: Jamie Carragher apologises to Aston Villa for 'wrong' language
articles.summary: Jamie Carragher apologises for "clumsy and wrong" language when linking manager Unai Emery with becoming Manchester United head coach, after Aston Villa threatened to sue him.
articles.body:
Jamie Carragher has apologised to Aston Villa , the club's owners and their fans for using "clumsy and wrong" language when linking manager Unai Emery with becoming Manchester United head coach.

On Friday, Villa said they would initiate legal action against the former England defender for what they described as "unacceptable insults".

The club's statement, signed by chairman Nassef Sawiris, referred to comments made by Carragher on the Stick to Football podcast, when he suggested Emery would want to manage a "giant" club.

He also told the club's fans to shut up, adding: " Aston Villa will never be Manchester United ."

Posting on social media on Saturday, Carragher said his comments were intended to be "tongue in cheek".

"I'd like to apologise to Aston Villa , the owners and their fans," the pundit wrote.

"My language this week was clumsy and wrong.

"I can assure Villa fans it was tongue in cheek but I can understand it's not come across that way, so apologies."

Manchester United manager Michael Carrick's position is hanging in the balance following a dismal start to the season.

Referring to former Paris St-Germain and Arsenal boss Emery, Carragher said on Stick to Football: "Surely he would want that opportunity to manage a giant again.

"There is a chain in football, whether you like it or not.

"So Real Madrid will take Manchester United 's best player, they did it with [Cristiano] Ronaldo. And there will be teams below Aston Villa , and they'll take their players or manager, so shut the [expletive] up Aston Villa fans. Aston Villa will never be Manchester United ."

After his comments attracted criticism from Villa fans, Carragher responded on social media, stating that telling them to shut up had been "a joke" and he had been praising Emery and the club "for years".

He reiterated on the Overlap Daily podcast that his message to Villa fans had been meant "in jest", adding: "I just think Unai Emery is the best manager in the league and if you're Man Utd you're thinking, what's the best we can get?"

articles.title: Mourinho: "¿El calendario? Un gran regalo que nos hace la Liga, las teles... A ver si quedan tristes"
articles.standfirst: El entrenador del Madrid no entiende no jugar antes con el Racing y hacerlo el sábado en Mestalla
articles.summary: El entrenador del Madrid no entiende no jugar antes con el Racing y hacerlo el sábado en Mestalla
articles.body: Lo primero que hizo José Mourinho al tomar la palabra en la sala de prensa de Valdebebas fue acordarse de la tragedia ferroviaria sufrida esta semana en Toledo. “Antes de comenzar, solo quería, en mi nombre y en el de todos los que trabajamos para el Real Madrid, transmitir nuestros sentimientos a los familiares y amigos de las víctimas de Urda. Nuestro abrazo, nuestro sentimiento y nuestro corazón”, explicó. Después arrancó una rueda de prensa en la que aparecieron muchos temas. El entrenador del Madrid volvió a poner el dedo en la llaga del calendario, en acumular pàrtidfos fuera de casa y en el trato recibido e n ls horarios: "Obviamente es peligroso. Cada partido lo es, sea en casa o fuera. Pero obviamente que debes añadir al público adversario en las salidas. Que los rivales se sienten más cómodos con su gente. El Racing es un equipo que no ha perdido en casa. Cuando vayamos a Atenas, el AEK jugará el derbi contra el Panathinaikos mañana, asi que o estará feliz o estará en crisis. Después de jugar el miércoles y llegar el jueves por la mañana... es una acumulación de dificultades que conocemos. Será difícil, pero ahí está nuestra resiliencia. Nuestra voluntad de ser inteligente. Pero difícil es; muy difícil. Creo que es una situación casi única lo de jugar cuatro partidos seguidos fuera de casa. Y sobre el calendario... deberíamos haber jugado ayer y jugamos mañana; deberíamos haber jugado el domingo el Valencia y jugamos el sábado. Metes dos días menos y concentras tres partidos en siete días. Es un grandísimo regalo que nos hacen, sea de LaLiga o de las teles, no lo sé. Pero es un regalo que tenemos que afrontar y ojalá los de regalo estén tristes". Otra respuesta importante fue al aparecer en tema del Balón de Oro: "Estoy muy feliz por Harry porque es un jugador y un chico que merece esta alegría, esta guinda a su carrera. Dentro de la frustración de que mi jugador no ha ganado, también tengo que ser honesto. Kylian es Kylian. Es único. Cada año tenemos un Balón de Oro, algunos han repetido, como Messi, Cristiano, Ronaldo o Platini. Pero el mejor jugador de la historia de los Mundiales hay solo uno. Es una cosa absolutamente única. De la votación, la cosa que me ha dejado todavía más sorprendido es Bellingham. Decimoprimero. No comment. Terminamos aquí". De Mabappé amplió en el aunto del Balón de Oro y del problema con China. "Yo sólo he visto y sentido clase y respeto por parte de Kylian. Una cosa es saber que eres el mejor y otra tener respeto por quien también ha hecho mucho para ganar un trofeo. En él sólo veo clase", dijo Mourinho sobre la reacción de Mbappé al Balón de Oro conquistado por Harry Kane. Sobre la polémica generada en China, el técnico destacó la madurez del delantero francés: "Kylian es muy inteligente, maduro, con un nivel de autoestima muy alto. Lo he visto también muy responsable con un club que a este nivel es de gran clase. De nuestra parte, ya está. No tenemos nada más que hacer". Además, advirtió sobre los riesgos del actual contexto mediático: "Son los peligros del mundo de hoy, donde muchas veces lo mejor que puedes hacer es no abrir la boca, porque existe peligro en muchísimas cosas que dices o comentas En el plano del partido de mañana, Mourinho aseguró que Valverde no estará en el once de Santander. Con esa percha, afrontó la situación en el lateral derecho. "Lo primero es que me duele. No me gusta crear malas sensaciones a los jugadores, sino buenas", admitió Mourinho al ser preguntado por la gestión del lateral derecho tras apostar por Fede Valverde en esa posición. "Cuando construyes una plantilla con una base de dos jugadores por posición y haces jugar a un tercero, es algo que no me gusta. Pero hay cosas más importantes que esos feelings. Hay cosas más importantes para el equipo en un determinado momento", explicó. El técnico justificó su decisión en clave colectiva: "He pensado que ahora era cambiar el centro del campo y meter a Fede ahí. Pero pensando en el equipo, no en los jugadores". Además, reveló que tanto Trent como Dumfries entendieron la situación: "He tenido una buena aceptación de Trent y Dumfries cuando he explicado que era una decisión por el equipo y no contra los jugadores". Por último, descartó cualquier problema de convivencia o una posible petición de salida: "Al final van a jugar todos. Mañana Valverde no será titular y sí uno de los otros. No pienso que me vayan a pedir ningún tipo de salida. Con tantos partidos, acumulación de tarjetas, cansancio y alguna lesión, todos van a jugar". Mourinho negó tene un once tipo. Y aseguró que está deseando tenerlo de vuelta: "Es no quiere decir que vaya a ser titular; sí que tenemos a un gran jugador más. Para nada es el equipo más equilbado sin él"- Y para cerrar, una reflexión sobre el entrenador que es hoy: "Con el paso de los años me considero más equilibrado. Si me critican, no me afecta. Y si dicen que he hecho esto, esto y esto, ya no lo como. De verdad", aseguró Mourinho al ser preguntado por la evolución de su forma de dirigir. El técnico restó protagonismo a su figura en el triunfo del Clásico: "Sigo pensando que el crédito de Barcelona es para los jugadores. Si salgo de un partido con la sensación de haber ayudado, salgo muy feliz. Pero totalmente equilibrado". Además, rechazó las etiquetas sobre un supuesto cambio de estilo: "No soy ni más valiente ni menos. El defensivo de la primera etapa es el defensivo de los 100 puntos y ciento y no sé cuántos goles. Me gustaría hacer tantos puntos y meter tantos goles esta temporada". Mourinho sí admitió una diferencia respecto a etapas anteriores: "No soy cabezón. Estoy abierto al estudio, a sacar conclusiones de las cosas que veo, escucho y debato. A veces no es sólo escuchar, sino también oler el trabajo de los jugadores". Por último, transmitió serenidad de cara al momento que vive el equipo: "Soy tranquilo, estoy tranquilo, como quiero que el equipo lo esté".

articles.title: Xabi Alonso deja al United al borde del descenso y a Carrick del despido
articles.standfirst: El Chelsea derrota a los Red Devils en una segunda parte en la que Lisandro fue expulsado
articles.summary: El Chelsea derrota a los Red Devils en una segunda parte en la que Lisandro fue expulsado
articles.body: El Manchester United sí que da miedo. Pese a la ratificación de Carrick entre semana, con la boca chica, los Red Devils volvieron a naufragar ante el Chelsea de Xabi Alonso, que acabó mareando a un rival que se quedó persiguiendo fantasmas. En el primer tiempo el United tiró de arrestos para igualar el partido e incluso Matheus Cunha marcó, aunque su gol fue anulado. Pero tras el descanso el equipo se deshizo como un azucarillo rojo, hasta quedar a merced de un Chelsea que no perdonó. Cunha perdió un balón en el centro del campo, Lavia se lo dejó a Morgan Rogers... que no encontró oposición hasta plantarse delante de Penders. Como si una fuerza invisible le protegiera, corrió al área y vio cómo Maguire, que se echó un lado, y Lisandro, que se fue al otro, le hacían un pasillo de honor para facilitarle el gol. El tanto dejó a los de Carrick de los nervios. Los pocos nervios que les deben quedar. En un córner, Lisandro se olvidó de defender y le pegó un golpe en la cara a Fofana que el VAR cazó. Penalti, segunda amarilla (la primera la había visto menos de cinco minutos antes) y gol de Cole Palmer para sentenciar. El rato que quedaba hasta el final sirvió para que Estevao se divirtiera (el VAR le anuló un golazo) y para que el trocito de grada del Manchester United se resignara. Si los resultados quieren, acabarán en descenso la jornada. La cara de Carrick camino del vestuario no era un "hasta mañana" y hace prever un adiós más largo.

articles.title: Chelsea v Man Utd player ratings: Rogers and Palmer make the difference - how did Martinez rate?
articles.summary: Player ratings as Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer score second-half goals in Chelsea's home win over Manchester United, who have Lisandro Martinez sent off.
articles.body:
Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer scored second-half goals as Chelsea secured a 2-0 home win over 10-man Manchester United , who endured another desperate day.

Chelsea 's record £117m signing Rogers opened the scoring in the 50th minute before United defender Lisandro Martinez was sent off after conceding a penalty, which Palmer converted.

Here's how BBC Sport's reporters at Stamford Bridge rated the players and your verdicts on the performances.

Chelsea beat 10-man Man Utd to heap further pressure on Carrick

What do BBC Sport's player ratings mean?

Mike Penders: The Belgian goalkeeper remains under pressure after his mistake against Tottenham last week, but he was steady here and made several comfortable saves. 7

Josh Acheampong : The young defender looked shaky early on but recovered well, making a fantastic block from a Bruno Fernandes volley and improving as the game went on. 6

Wesley Fofana : The Frenchman made a brilliant block from one of Amad Diallo's shots but was twice at fault as the winger broke clear on the counter-attack. His header also struck the post after taking a deflection off Moises Caicedo in a chaotic display. Fofana also won the second-half penalty. 5

Levi Colwill : The England defender was part of an overall poor defensive display but did not make any obvious errors himself. 6

Marco Palestra : The Italian made some good recovery runs on his first start for Chelsea but was also part of a below-par defensive display from an organisational perspective. 7

Moises Caicedo : Influential presence in a scrappy midfield battle, helping Chelsea compete physically in the centre of the pitch. 6

Romeo Lavia : Often the player who helped Chelsea play through United's pressure, sparking several counter-attacks with intelligent passing. Won the ball for Chelsea 's opener. 7

Pedro Neto : Arguably Chelsea 's most dangerous attacker but finishing let him down, with one effort saved and another fired well wide in the first half. 6

Cole Palmer : A quiet game by his standards and unconvincingly scored a second-half penalty. Aside from that, he attempted an ambitious effort from inside his own half and gifted United one of their major chances. 6

Estevao Willian : Lost possession with his first touch but recovered impressively. Looked lively throughout, having a couple of dangerous-looking shots on goal and two that he scored but were ruled out for offside. His set-pieces were also of consistent high quality. 8

Morgan Rogers : A surprisingly anonymous start and struggled in the number nine position until he was given the chance to run at United's defence, scoring with a sublime dink in the 50th minute. 8

Pep Chavarria (on 71, Palestra): Game was already won when he entered. 6

Senne Lammens: Alive to Palmer's attempt to catch him out with a quickly taken free-kick. Was lucky to get away with a poor save early on, thanks to offside flag. Solid after that. No chance with Rogers goal. 7

Leny Yoro: Speed essential to deal with Chelsea counter-attacks but sometimes ran out of position. 7

Harry Maguire: Authoritative presence at heart of defence for most part but yet again unable to stop gap opening up for Rogers to score. 7

Lisandro Martinez: Did OK and looked good - until Chelsea scored. Then gave penalty away and red-carded for ridiculous moment of recklessness. 3

Diogo Dalot: Played out of position again at left-back and Estevao threatened down his side, but Dalot stuck to his task gamely. 6

Andrey Santos: So close to a memorable goal against his old club. Crucial intervention to deny Moises Caicedo a clear sight at goal at the other end. Difficult second half. 5

Carlos Baleba: Was having his best game in a United shirt so far and tried to prod the visitors forward. But impetuous tackle in midfield proved extremely costly as Rogers ran through to score. 5

Amad Diallo: Looked sharp. Tested Mike Penders from long range and also at his near post. Fofana blocked another goal-bound effort. Should have scored before half-time. 7

Bruno Fernandes: Returned as captain and should have put the visitors ahead when Mbeumo picked him out. Nearly set up Mbeumo. Better but not brilliant. 6

Matheus Cunha: Most impact of any recent game. Linked well with the visitors' attack but didn't threaten a goal. 6

Bryan Mbeumo: Set up a chance for Fernandes, then nearly reached a far-post cross from his captain. Gave Chelsea a problem but couldn't get last bit right. 6

Kobbie Mainoo (on 58, Baleba): Not on long enough to make an impact before Martinez red. After that it was damage limitation. 6

Ayden Heaven (on 66, Andrey Santos): Time for a regular start? 5

Mason Mount (on 66, Cunha): Usual abuse from the home fans and nothing to answer it with. 5

After the opportunity to rate players has closed, the score displayed represents the average from all the submissions by BBC Sport users.

articles.title: Man Utd boss Michael Carrick expects to remain in charge vs Roma despite winless run stretching to nine matches
articles.summary: Man Utd's winless run has now stretched to nine matches in all competitions; Michael Carrick’s side could end the weekend in the Premier League relegation zone; however, the under-pressure head coach dismissed talk of a survival battle after the 2-0 defeat at Chelsea
articles.body:
Manchester United imploded in the second half at Stamford Bridge, with Lisandro Martinez sent off after conceding a penalty that allowed Cole Palmer to put the result beyond doubt. The defender had earlier been at fault for Morgan Rogers' opening goal, capping a disastrous afternoon for United.

Carrick's side have not won any of their last nine matches across all competitions, their worst such run since September 1984, and could end the weekend in the Premier League's relegation zone.

But the United head coach, who was widely expected to be sacked after last Sunday's 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth, is anticipating he will still be in post for Tuesday's Champions League game against Roma at Old Trafford.

Asked by TNT Sports if he expects to be in charge for that game, Carrick said: "Yeah."

Pressed further on his future in the post-match news conference, the United head coach said: "I'm just looking forward to getting the boys ready for midweek now."

United have failed to win any of their first seven away games in all competitions in a season for the first time since 1973-74, when they were last relegated.

Asked if the team is equipped for the mentality shift of being around the bottom three, Carrick said: "You can look at it like that. You can also look at how far you can move up the league quite quickly if you win football matches. That's the way it has to be approached for sure."

Carrick continues to enjoy the backing of United's matchgoing fans, who sang his chant as he approached the away end to applaud them at full-time at Stamford Bridge.

The players received a much more positive response from the supporters than after the defeat to Bournemouth, although there was a smattering of boos that were drowned out by the majority.

Asked about those boos, Carrick told TNT Sports : "There is a lot of emotion. We are a great football club but we want to win football matches. The supporters make a lot of effort and pay a lot of money to watch us play.

"You could see today [Saturday] the boys had the game in the right place and things have gone against us in a big way and unravelled quite quickly. There is a lot of emotion right now."

"The supporters have been absolutely amazing," Carrick continued in his post-match news conference. "The way they're not just turning up, it's the effort, the money they spend for that for sure.

"They've been really tested at the moment and they've gone through some really big highs over the years and it's easy to go the other way, but the way they've stuck by all of us and supported the team and went through the second half in difficult circumstances, stayed behind, that sums up exactly what they're all about.

"We've got to give them something to really get their teeth into in a good direction.

"I'm not clinging to the first half as a huge positive, but I think that's the type of feelings and performances that we've got to give to them. Massively appreciate them for being what they are and they're showing everything they are at the moment."

Carrick did not acknowledge Martinez when he walked off the pitch after his second-half sending off.

However, the United head coach refused to blame the defender for the defeat when asked about the red card incident after the game.

Carrick, who insisted he did not watch the incident back, replied "no" when asked if he felt Martinez had let him down in his post-match interview with TNT Sports .

articles.title: Edin Terzic: "En un derbi hay que ganar, eso es lo importante ahora"
articles.standfirst: El técnico alemán afronta con ilusión su primer derbi y destaca la mejoría ofensiva del Athletic
articles.summary: El técnico alemán afronta con ilusión su primer derbi y destaca la mejoría ofensiva del Athletic
articles.body: El Athletic recibe este domingo a la Real Sociedad en San Mamés en un derbi que Edin Terzic afronta con ilusión y con la intención de prolongar la mejoría de su equipo. El técnico alemán ha analizado el estado de la plantilla, el momento de los donostiarras y la importancia de un encuentro que vivirá por primera vez como entrenador rojiblanco. Su primer derbi oficial: “Cuando jugamos contra ellos hace un par de semanas ya sentí lo importante que es este partido para todos en el club. Es mi primer derbi aquí y también mi primer partido de noche en San Mamés. He tenido la suerte de vivir muchos derbis como entrenador, en Dortmund, Londres y Estambul. Los derbis están llenos de emociones y tenemos que estar preparados para mostrarlas cuando sea necesario, controlarlas cuando corresponda y jugar con la cabeza fría”. La importancia de ganar el derbi: “Si pierdes un derbi puedes pensar que has perdido tres puntos, pero con una victoria puedes ganar algo más que tres puntos y enviar un mensaje. Al final es un partido de fútbol, un partido muy importante. Para mí la única diferencia es ganar o perder, independientemente de dónde juguemos o contra quién. Mañana vamos a salir a ganar”. El momento de la Real Sociedad: “Tienen un gran entrenador. Rino les dio estabilidad y una idea clara desde que llegó. Después de cuatro victorias consecutivas en Liga están en un buen momento y tienen mucha confianza. Es un equipo al que le gusta presionar, pero que también puede defender en bloque medio y ser muy peligroso al contragolpe. Tienen mucha movilidad y rotaciones en el centro del campo”. La mejoría ofensiva del Athletic: “Creo que nosotros también estamos en un buen momento, especialmente después de una semana en la que hemos sido capaces de marcar diez goles. Hemos ganado confianza con estas dos actuaciones. Respetamos al rival, pero vamos a preocuparnos un poco más de nosotros mismos”. Peio Canales: “Con Peio puedo jugar en cualquier posición y contra cualquier rival, porque es un jugador increíble y muy importante para nosotros. Ayer y hoy ha podido entrenar. Nos aporta mucha confianza y creatividad. Puede jugar de seis, de ocho o de diez. Estamos muy contentos de que vuelva a estar sin dolor y disponible”. La situación de Álvaro Djaló: “Álvaro ha tenido problemas médicos durante las últimas semanas después de regresar con una infección. Ha trabajado individualmente y le hemos hecho pruebas prácticamente todos los días. El jueves recibimos el visto bueno de los médicos para que pudiera volver a entrenar con el equipo y jugar. Ha estado unas tres semanas y media sin entrenar con nosotros, pero ayer y hoy ha completado las sesiones. Ahora tiene que recuperar el trabajo perdido”. El reconocimiento a Unai Simón: “Es un ejemplo en todos los aspectos de la vida, tanto como deportista como persona. Para mí, lo más importante es el mensaje que transmite a todos los niños y niñas del club. Ha demostrado que puedes ganar títulos y premios individuales sin tener que marcharte. Puedes alcanzar lo más alto del fútbol mundial jugando en el Athletic Club”. El homenaje a la ikurriña: “Soy consciente de lo que ocurrió hace 50 años con Iribar llevando la bandera. Creo que fue un momento muy importante, de orgullo y valentía. También demuestra la conexión entre los dos clubes, que tienen muchas cosas en común en su historia. Vamos a repetir una ceremonia muy similar y creo que es un gran mensaje para el mundo, especialmente en estos tiempos en los que todavía hay personas luchando por sus derechos y su libertad”. Cómo frenar a las figuras de la Real: “Tienen jugadores de mucha calidad. No podemos centrarnos solamente en uno porque hay otros muy buenos a su alrededor. Tenemos que encontrar el equilibrio entre respetar al rival, conocer los espacios que debemos proteger y aprovechar aquellos en los que podemos hacer daño. Si hablamos de preocupaciones, queremos ser nosotros quienes se las generemos al rival”.

articles.summary: Tres puntos vitales gracias al golazo de Grimaldo, 'reemplazo' del actual jugador madridista.
articles.body: El Atlético visitó el Ciutat de Valencia, uno de los estadios que peor se le da a los rojiblancos las últimas temporadas (tres empates seguidos). El triunfo le coloca, de momento, como líder de LaLiga. Oblak, otra vez capitán ante el baja de Koke. A los 10 minutos ya había realizado el primer paradón marca de la casa. Hacer estas paradas cuando el partido está igualado da muchísimos puntos. Nota final: 8 Como a todo el equipo, le costó entrar en el partido el primer cuarto de hora. Luego, el Llorente de siempre. Un disparo lejano en el 29' fue una de las primeras ocasiones rojiblancas. Nota final: 6 Volvía a casa, donde recibió una ovación. Arrancó mucho más enchufado que en los últimos partidos. Recordó al de la temporada pasada. Nota final: 7 Sufrió en los primeros lances ante el empuje local. Le anularon un gol por fuera de juego tras una falta de Julián. Bien atrás y en ataque. Nota final: 7 Cada vez progresa más en defensa. En ataque siempre suma... como se demostró en el 0-1 donde su zurdazo imparable culminó un gran pase de Baena. Es el cuarto de la temporada. No sería posible si Cucurella no hubiera elegido el Madrid. Nota final: 8 Como siempre, de los más incisivos e intensos tanto en ataque como en defensa. Se le fue arriba un buen zurdazo en el arranque de la segunda parte. Marcó el 0-2 para dejar sentenciado el partido. Nota final: 8 Es normal que Simeone le ponga siempre pese al riesgo de lesión. Cada balón que toca lo mejora. Y eso sólo lo hacen él y Koke. Esta vez aguantó 75 minutos sobre el campo. Nota final: 7 Le anularon un gol por fuera de juego en el que había dejado un gran control y definición. Sacó una ocasión clara desde el suelo. Nota final: 6 Su pase a Hjulmand en el gol anulado es oro puro. El 10 está de dulce y no parece que vaya a bajar el nivel... y también dio el pase a Grimaldo en el 0-1 que sí subió al marcador. Asistió también en el 0-2 a Giuliano. Mr. asistencias. Nota final: 8 Como siempre, lo intentó desde lejos cada vez que pudo. Mandó un zurdazo al larguero tras un jugadón de Pablo Barrios. Nota final: 6 Aunque lo intentó, estuvo muy desaparecido durante la primera parte. Tampoco, aunque lo intentó, tuvo éxito en la segunda. Cambiado en el 65' y sin poder marcar en su tercer partido seguido. Nota final: 5 Primer cambio de Simeone junto a Jonathan David. Sin ocasiones de estrenarse esta temporada. Nota final: 5 Salió junto a Sorloth para ocupar el lugar de Julián. No tuvo protagonismo. Nota final: 5 El central salió para reforzar la defensa y aguantar el 0-2 en el último cuarto de hora. Bien achicando balones en el intento final del Levante por meterse en el partido. Nota final: 6 Salió el último cuarto de hora buscando recuperar su nivel de la temporada pasada. Necesita recuperar la confianza, aunque el nivel altísimo de la plantilla juega en su contra. Nota final: 5 Cambios respecto a la única prueba que realizó esta semana. Cuti, fuera del once, así como Jonathan David. Volvió a acertar en la que es la séptima victoria seguida en LaLiga. Para él, la 344, Para Simeone, igualar a Luis como el entrenador con más victorias de la historia de LaLiga. Nota final: 10

articles.title: Al Atlético se le está poniendo una cara de campeón...
articles.standfirst: Aunque su liderato puede durar horas si gana el Barcelona, los síntomas que arrojan los de Simeone confirman su candidatura al título
articles.summary: Aunque su liderato puede durar horas si gana el Barcelona, los síntomas que arrojan los de Simeone confirman su candidatura al título
articles.body: Puede ser que su liderato sea por unas horas si el Barcelona solventa la visita del Alavés al Camp Nou, pero lo que nadie le va a quitar ya al Atlético es la cara de campeón que se le está poniendo. Su asalto momentáneo a lo más alto de la Liga es tan sintomático como que los partidos lejos del Metropolitano se le han dejado de atragantar. Donde antes había salidas gafes como la del Ciutat, Mendizorroza o el RCD Stadium, ahora hay triunfos inapelables. Y en Anoeta. Y en el Pizjuán. También dice mucho que los últimos siete encuentros ligueros (derbi incluido) se hayan saldado con 21 puntos posibles. Queda mucho, partido a partido, pero la apariencia no engaña. El Clásico de la semana pasada evidenció que con las calabazas (veraniegas, no de Halloween) de Cucurella, el Atlético perdió a un anti Lamine. Sin embargo, desde ese mismo momento ganó a un cañón con Grimaldo. El que tiene en su pierna izquierda disparó a Ryan a !116 kilómetros por hora! desde dentro del área. Como para pararlo. Dicen que los delanteros viven del gol. Y el lateral izquierdo también. Había empezado con muchas dudas su andadura rojiblanco por su endeblez defensiva, sin embargo, sería marcar ante la Real, aunque fuera de penalti, y destaparse como un filón para Simeone. De momento, ya lleva cuatro dianas. Fue defensivo, violento, aburrido, dependiente únicamente del balón parado, 'amarrategui'... y todo lo que a sus entrañables críticos se les ha ido ocurriendo en estos 14 años en los que no sólo ha cambiado la historia del Atlético, sino de la Liga. Pero obviamente la realidad estropea sus relatos. Quedaremos a la espera de saber cómo ha podido llegar a igualar las 344 victorias de Luis Aragonés habiendo disputado ¡192 partidos menos! Su obra, aún inacabada, ya queda para los libros. Se estudiará con el paso de los años, como dijo en MARCA Diego Martínez, uno de los tantos colegas que se rinden a su capacidad para reinventarse y mantenerse vigente. Por lo pronto, se pasea como la mayor leyenda de los banquillos en casi un siglo de vida de un campeonato que sí que no puede explicarse sin sus incontestables números. Aunque todos se mueven al son de la batuta de un Barrios que sencillamente juega a otro deporte, la orquesta que dirige desde el verde tiene todo tipo de registros. El segundo gol, de hecho, fue una fusión del rock&roll de Giuliano y la pausa de Baena. El argentino se marcó un sprint de 100 metros lisos de Juegos Olímpicos sin preocuparse de nada más mientras el 10 esperaba el momento exacto de entregarle el balón. Eso sí, la maniobra para resolver ante Ryan, tampoco estuvo exenta de delicadeza. La misma con la que Álex ya había asistido también previamente en el gol anulado a Hjulmand y en el 0-1 de Giuliano. Pese al resultado final y la superioridad rojiblanca, no debe olvidarse que, como tantas y tantas veces, todo empieza con una parada de Oblak a la altura de sus seis Zamoras. El Levante había salido a hacer buena la leyenda negra del Ciutat para el Atlético, pero lo que se topó tras diez minutos de rebato sería a la leyenda de la Liga. El esloveno volaría a su escuadra para evitar el gol de Requena aunque aún tendría tiempo, ya con 0-2, para agigantarse ante Etta- Eyong en el área pequeña y demostrar que pese a su enésima portería a cero y sus 410 partidos en el campeonato, aún tiene cuerda para rato porque sus paradas son ilimitadas.

articles.title: El Sanse vuelve a ganar casi dos meses después
articles.standfirst: Un gol de Astiazaran casi al final deja sin puntos a un Girona que jugó desde el 15' con un futbolista menos por la expulsión de David López por un penalti que detuvo Gazzaniga
articles.summary: Un gol de Astiazaran casi al final deja sin puntos a un Girona que jugó desde el 15' con un futbolista menos por la expulsión de David López por un penalti que detuvo Gazzaniga
articles.body: Un gol de Lander Astiazaran casi al final del partido le dio al Sanse una victoria con la que puso fin a una racha de seis derrotas seguidas. El Girona jugó desde el minuto 15 con un futbolista menos por expulsión de David López, en una acción en la que hizo un penalti que detuvo Gazzaniga. El Girona comenzó dominando y teniendo la primera ocasión, un remate flojo de Vanat a las manos de Olasagasti. Lebarbier protagonizó una acción parecida en la que pudo ser objeto de penalti en el momento del chut, como así lo consideró el árbitro, tras ser llamado por el VAR, expulsando además a David López, cuando sólo se llevaban 15 minutos de juego. Gazzaniga estuvo espectacular, al detener a Dani Díaz su lanzamiento y también el posterior remate tras su rechace. El conjunto visitante siguió teniendo la pelota pese a estar con uno menos y un centrochut de Balda al larguero fue la única oportunidad del Sanse antes del descanso. Otro centrochut de Balda se fue rozando el poste izquierdo de la portería gironí nada más volver de los vestuarios. Con los txuriurdin ahora sí muy dominadores, Ansotegi metió de una tacada a Aguirre, Eceizabarrena, Astiazaran y Carrera, respondiendo Quique González con la entrada de, entre otros, Portu. Nada más entrar, el ex de la Real remató a las manos de Olasagasti y luego dio un gran pase a Carles Pérez, que no acertó en una gran ocasión para el 0-2. Fue aún mejor la que volvió a tener el 23 del Girona tras error en la salida de balón de Kita, pero de nuevo se topó con Kita. Cuando el 0-0 parecía inamovible, Astiazaran marcó para adelantar al Sanse y, tras detener Gazzaniga los disparos de Carrera y Eceizabarrena, darle un triunfo importantísimo.

articles.title: Aramburu es nombre de derbi
articles.standfirst: El venezolano apunta a volver a ser en San Mamés el lateral derecho titular mes y medio después, recuperado ya de la lesión muscular que sufrió al volver de su selección
articles.summary: El venezolano apunta a volver a ser en San Mamés el lateral derecho titular mes y medio después, recuperado ya de la lesión muscular que sufrió al volver de su selección
articles.body: Jon Mikel Aramburu apunta a ser este domingo la gran novedad en un equipo titular de la Real Sociedad al que regresará mes y medio después, el tiempo que ha estado primero con su selección y luego de baja por una lesión muscular que se produjo nada más regresar a San Sebastián tras el anterior parón internacional. El de Venezuela recuperará parece su puesto en el lateral derecho, en el que en su ausencia Pellegrino Matarazzo ha utilizado a hasta cuatro futbolistas diferentes. Aramburu estaba siendo titular habitual y además uno de los mejores futbolistas de la Real en el inicio de curso cuando el pasado 7 de octubre el club txuriurdin comunicó que había sufrido una lesión en el sóleo, cuando tras volver de la concentración con Venezuela comenzó a preparar a las órdenes de Matarazzo la vuelta a LaLiga ante el Dépor. Su sustituto, en teoría, apuntaba a ser Héctor Fort, pero el técnico de Nueva Jersey prefirió mantenerle en un segundo plano, después de su mal estreno como titular en Anoeta, cuando le cambió en el descanso y movió a Luken Beitia a la derecha, y alineó a Pablo Marín. El riojano fue expulsado y salió a ocupar su lugar Igor Zubeldia, que repitió unos días después en la visita europea al Union Saint-Gilloise. En el siguiente encuentro, en Málaga, Matarazzo dio una nueva oportunidad a Fort, que jugó una hora, siendo reemplazado de nuevo por Zubeldia, de nuevo el elegido para el importantísimo partido de Europa League en Lillestrom. El fichaje catalán volvió a ser de la partida el domingo pasado ante el Levante y otra vez a la hora de juego fue sustituido, entrando en esta ocasión un Jon Mikel Aramburu que apenas llevaba dos entrenamientos con el grupo, pero que está recuperado ya de ese problema muscular que sufrió hace más de tres semanas y que todo apunta a que volverá a ser titular mes y medio después en un derbi en el que se estrenó con derrota, para luego enlazar cinco sin perder, con tres victorias y dos empates.

articles.title: Chelsea beat Man United as Martinez sent off to pile pressure on Carrick
articles.summary: Goals from Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer give Chelsea a 2-0 win over Manchester United in the Premier League.
articles.body:
Michael Carrick’s stay of execution as Manchester United boss may not last long after his team imploded in a 2-0 Premier League loss at Chelsea.

The visitors wasted a string of chances to take the lead at Stamford Bridge on Saturday before Morgan Rogers waltzed through the heart of the United defence to open the scoring on 50 minutes.

Lisandro Martinez then ruined any chance of a revival from Carrick’s men with two quickfire yellow cards, the second of which also conceded a penalty converted by Cole Palmer.

Winless in nine games, their defeat leaves the 20-time English champions still just one point above the relegation zone and in danger of ending the weekend in the bottom three.

Many expected Carrick to be axed following last weekend’s 3-0 home defeat to Bournemouth.

The former United midfielder was instead given the chance to turn his side’s fortunes around and will lament a lack of ruthlessness during the first half.

Carrick recalled captain Bruno Fernandes after he was left out last weekend in the wake of criticising his manager’s tactics during the 4-1 thrashing at Como in the Champions League.

Fernandes should have marked his return with the opener when he blazed over from Bryan Mbeumo’s inviting cross.

The roles were reversed when Mbeumo could not stretch to meet Fernandes’s delivery at the back post before Amad Diallo was twice denied by Chelsea’s stand-in goalkeeper Mike Penders.

United did finally get the ball in the net when Matheus Cunha turned in Harry Maguire’s header from a corner, but the Brazilian had strayed just offside.

Carrick could not hide his frustration in a half-time interview with broadcasters and his mood soured further with a disastrous start to the second period.

Chelsea’s Rogers credits Carrick for revitalising his career during a spell together at Middlesbrough, but dealt a potentially decisive blow to his former boss.

The England international collected the ball inside the centre circle but was allowed to drive directly towards the United goal before dinking the ball over Senne Lammens.

Martinez also spoke out publicly in recent weeks to criticise United’s lack of spending in the transfer market to bolster Carrick’s squad.

But on this season’s evidence, Martinez is one of those most in need of replacing.

The Argentine international could not cope with Rogers’s strength moments later as he was penalised for hauling back the Chelsea forward.

From the resulting free-kick, Martinez then needlessly crashed into Wesley Fofana with a raised forearm.

After a VAR review, referee Peter Banks awarded a penalty and showed Martinez a second yellow card.

Lammens got hands to Palmer’s spot-kick but still allowed the ball to trickle into the bottom corner.

On a rare start since Xabi Alonso took charge of the Blues, Estevao had a third goal disallowed for offside when he crashed a pass from Palmer into the top corner.

Cries of “sacked in the morning” rained down from the Chelsea fans as their side toyed with United for the final quarter without adding to their lead.

Another big decision awaits the United hierarchy before the massive Champions League clash at home to Roma on Tuesday.

Beaten in two of their three European games so far, United face both the embarrassment and financial shock of an early exit should they fall to another defeat against the Italians at Old Trafford.

articles.title: Harry Kane won Ballon d'Or by just 28 points from Kylian Mbappe - see how top 10 scored
articles.summary: Voting figures show Harry Kane beat second-placed Kylian Mbappe to the men's Ballon d'Or by one of the tightest winning margins in the award's history.
articles.body:
Harry Kane beat second-placed Kylian Mbappe to the men's Ballon d'Or by just 28 points - one of the smallest winning margins in the award's history.

Organisers released voting numbers on Saturday, showing that England captain Kane was awarded 1,055 points, compared with 1,027 for Real Madrid's France forward Mbappe.

Bayern Munich striker Kane became the first Englishman to win the award since Michael Owen in 2001, while France talisman Mbappe also claimed his best finish, ending up well clear of Spain forward Lamine Yamal, who was third with 881 points.

It was the smallest winning margin since Argentina great Lionel Messi beat Liverpool defender Virgil van Dijk by seven points in 2019, while the men's Ballon d'Or has twice been decided by a single point.

That happened when England World Cup winner Bobby Charlton, who was later knighted, beat Portugal star Eusebio by the smallest possible margin in 1966, and Germany defender Matthias Sammer repeated the tight one-point victory when he edged out Brazil striker Ronaldo in 1996.

Mbappe may take heart from Ronaldo's Ballon d'Or experience as the legendary frontman, who presented Kane with his award in London on Monday, went on to win in 1997 and again in 2002.

Kane clinched the prize after scoring 73 goals in 65 matches last season, helping Bayern Munich to a league and cup double and leading England to a third-place finish at the World Cup.

The award is decided by votes from 100 journalists, using a weighted points system.

Speaking about Mbappe missing out on the award, Real Madrid head coach Jose Mourinho said the 27-year-old was dealing brilliantly with the disappointment.

"Kylian is very intelligent and mature. He has very high self-esteem. And at the same time, he has class," Mourinho said before Real's game against Racing Santander on Sunday in La Liga.

"The way he handled the Ballon d'Or for Harry… all I saw and felt was class. And respect.

"It's one thing to know you're the best, and another to have respect for someone who has also worked hard to win a trophy. All I see in him is class."

articles.title: Chelsea 2-0 Man Utd: Estevao Willian and Morgan Rogers bring X-factor in Premier League win
articles.summary: Morgan Rogers swings the match in Chelsea's favour as Estevao Willian dazzles, making a mystery of his limited action under Xabi Alonso this season.
articles.body:
Estevao Willian had not started a Premier League match this season before his electric display against Manchester United on Saturday.

The 19-year-old winger was an unused substitute for the midweek penalty shootout defeat by Liverpool but was still serenaded with chants from away fans at Anfield.

Three days later, after questions had been raised about the Brazil international's lack of opportunities, Chelsea supporters made their feelings clear.

Early on against United at Stamford Bridge, supporters chanted "Steve-o", their tongue-in-cheek nickname for the £38m signing from Palmeiras.

This time he was on the field, making things happen in a team that lacked a recognised striker, and the loud backing from the stands appeared justified.

Estevao had an early goal ruled out for offside before another fine near-post finish in the second half was disallowed - a marginal decision.

At the end of his 86-minute display in the Blues' 2-0 victory, Estevao received a standing ovation from the home crowd and a hug from Chelsea head coach Xabi Alonso.

He had six shots, the joint-most by a Chelsea player in a Premier League match this season, along with a host of other impressive attacking contributions.

He recorded 12 touches in the opposition penalty area, created three chances, delivered eight crosses and completed five dribbles - all either the most or joint-most by a Chelsea player in Saturday's match.

Estevao's limited recent involvement remains curious. Before this, he had made only one start this season, against League One side Luton Town in the Carabao Cup in September.

It has led to speculation in the Brazilian media that he is unhappy or pushing for a move.

However, both publicly and privately, sources at Chelsea and those close to Estevao have suggested no signs of discontent.

There has been widespread praise for his professionalism behind the scenes and a feeling that he has been unfortunate, not least with the form of Morgan Rogers, Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro, which has limited his opportunities.

Chelsea 's tendency to score first or take early leads has also meant more defensive options have often been chosen from the bench.

There was talk before Saturday's match that Alonso was keeping his plans to start Estevao against Manchester United under wraps, having faced questions from the media about the winger in the build-up.

He confirmed after the victory that the decision had already been made. In fact, it was made in the aftermath of last weekend's home defeat by Tottenham .

"We spoke after Tottenham and he knew that he was going to be playing tonight, today," Alonso said.

"He has had the best response to show that he deserves more, that he was prepared, and that's what you want from a football player, so I'm very happy for him.

"He deserved to enjoy his game. He had a good connection with the crowd. He was really close to scoring that goal. At the end he fought really hard. He was tired and it has been a good day for him."

The performance will only increase pressure on Alonso to keep Estevao in the side and ensure this was not a one-off.

Chelsea beat 10-man Man Utd to heap further pressure on Carrick

Rogers shines, 3/10 for sent-off Martinez - player ratings for Chelsea v Man Utd

Martinez's 'inexplicable' 83 seconds cost Man Utd and Carrick

Chelsea looked rudderless until Rogers took the game by the scruff of the neck in the 50th minute.

Receiving the ball from midfielder Romeo Lavia, the £117m club record signing slalomed through the Manchester United defence before lifting a delicate chip over Senne Lammens.

It was a moment of magic, described by TNT Sports pundit and former Chelsea attacker Joe Cole as "Gascoigne-esque", and one that exposed United's poor defending.

The goal came after Michael Carrick's visitors had dominated the first half but failed to take their chances, with Rogers' strike settling a disjointed Chelsea team.

Serious problems remain for Chelsea , not least the absence of eight players before kick-off, with first-choice striker Joao Pedro's injury arguably the most damaging in the short term.

The Brazilian suffered a thigh injury before the 2-0 home loss to Tottenham , a match that produced Chelsea 's poorest attacking display of the season and the first time they had failed to score at Stamford Bridge.

Rogers struggled as a central striker in that game, while alternative option Danny Welbeck, signed from Brighton in the summer, remained on the bench.

However, after scoring in the penalty shootout defeat at Liverpool in midweek, Alonso kept faith with Rogers up front and was rewarded.

The solo effort was Rogers' sixth goal of the season in all competitions, to go with four assists. The forward has now been involved in 10 goals in 13 appearances, while no Chelsea player has featured more often this season.

Rogers became just the second Premier League player, after Manchester City striker Erling Haaland, to reach 10 goal involvements.

Palmer's first goal in six games came from the penalty spot and effectively sealed victory, following a week on from his red card in the defeat by Spurs .

Although Chelsea remain a work in progress structurally, with Alonso saying his side will "look very different" and be "better" by the end of the season, their attack remains potent enough to outgun opponents.

Once again, with so many available attacking options, Alonso kept United guessing, with Rogers and winger Pedro Neto often in central positions.

It worked on this occasion as two natural strikers, Welbeck and Emmanuel Emegha, were left on the bench.

"Today has worked really well," Alonso said. "We need to be creative at times and try to find solutions with the players available. Even Pedro [Neto] has worked really hard in that position. It's not new for him."

articles.summary: Sexto partido consecutivo que los de Mánchester no son capaces de ganar en los 90' ante un Brighton que es tercero
articles.body: Pocos equipos se le dan tan mal al Manchester City como el Brighton. Desde el 0-4 de abril de 2024, los 'sky blues' acumulaban cinco encuentros siendo incapaces de ganar a los del sur en los 90'. Hace unos días, de hecho, los habían superado en la Carabao Cup... pero en la tanda de penaltis. Y este sábado, en el Etihad, llegó el sexto. Los de Hurzeler asaltaron Mánchester con un solitario gol de Ayari y una actuación brillante de Verbruggen bajo palos. Segunda derrota consecutiva en Premier para los de Maresca. Un resultado que deja al City a las puertas de perder el liderato y aprieta la Premier League. Si este domingo puntúa el Arsenal en Anfield, los de Arteta serán líderes de nuevo. Todo se decidió a los 10 minutos de partido con un solitario gol de Yasin Ayari. Con algo de fortuna en el 'pase' de De Cuyper y un mal balance defensivo del City... pero el equipo de Hurzeler, tercero antes de arrancar la jornada, confirmaba su buen arranque de curso en Mánchester. A los mancunianos, mientras, le costaba mucho entrar en el partido. Chema Andrés, con amarilla, se hacía fuerte en el mediocampo visitante y los de Maresca únicamente encontraban el peligro cuando cargaban por la derecha con Anderson y Ndoye. Fueron ambos los que tuvieron las más claras pero Verbruggen en la portería y Dunk en defensa estaban imperiales. Nada cambió demasiado tras el descanso. El City seguí asediando pero el Brighton encontraba espacios y hacía sufrir a la zaga 'sky blue'. De Cuyper perdonó y Verbruggen terminó de levantar un muro absolutamente impenetrable. El neerlandés firmó una de las paradas del fin de semana ante Matheus Nunes y Ndiaye que se fue al banaquillo sin marcar después de toparse con el palo tras desviar previamente el meta del Brighton. A favor del equipo de Maresca quedó la insistencia y la búsqueda constante del empate... pero sin premio. El MVP fue Verbruggen y, por si había dudas, lo confirmó con otra mano clave ante Khusanov y un 'pechazo' frente a Doku. El City chocó contra el de Países Bajos y se dejó tres puntos que igualan la Premier League en la segunda derrota consecutiva tras caer hace una semana contra el Villa de Emery.

articles.title: Coventry 3-1 Sunderland: Frank Lampard's side climb out of Premier League relegation zone with win over rock bottom Black Cats
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights as Coventry beat Sunderland 3-1 in the Premier League; goals from Tatsuhiro Sakamoto, Taiwo Awoniyi and Jack Rudoni gave Frank Lampard's side third Premier League win of the season; Enzo Le Fee's penalty means little as Sunderland remain bottom
articles.body:
Frank Lampard had called for his side to show a response after a disappointing defeat to Fulham last time out, and got exactly what he was after as they were rampant against a sluggish Black Cats.

A fast start was rewarded as Tatsuhiro Sakamoto finished beautifully from the edge of the box for his first Premier League goal. The lead was doubled when Taiwo Awoniyi dispossessed Luke O'Nien before driving into the penalty area and finding his first league goal since joining the club in the summer.

Any hopes of a fast start from the visitors in the second half were put to bed as Jack Rudoni's effort from the edge of the box deflected off Omar Alderete and left Robin Roefs stranded.

Sunderland had chances to cut the deficit earlier, but it took an Enzo Le Fee penalty after Ethan Pinnock handled in the penalty area to finally beat Carl Rushworth - the club's first Premier League goal since September 20.

A late red card for Alderete only soured things further for Regis Le Bris' men, who remain at the foot of the table. However, Coventry leapfrog the likes of Manchester United as they climb out of the bottom three with their third Premier League win of the season.

17: GOAL! Sakamoto nets his first Premier League goal to give Coventry deserved lead.

21: WIDE! Brobbey drags a shot across goal off target.

28: SAVE! Roefs tips Torp's free-kick behind.

36: GOAL! Awoniyi wins the ball off O'Nien before slotting in Coventry's second.

52: GOAL! Rudoni's deflected strike makes it three.

59: WIDE! Talbi misses golden chance to pull one back.

67: GOAL! Le Fee's penalty sees Sunderland cut lead to two.

90+9: RED CARD! Alderete shown second yellow card as Sunderland's misery compounded.

Lampard proud of 'professional' Coventry performance

Coventry boss Frank Lampard speaking with Sky Sports:

"The performance was really good. I thought we started the game well and continued to get our rewards for that.

"From beginning to end, in the different modes of the game. Even when it went to 3-1 and we had to see it out professionally, I thought we did.

"I love the way we approached it. Don't sit back, keep pushing and doing the same things, but it won't always be that way.

"We dealt with the stuff at the end of the game as well. It ended up being relatively comfortable with the two-goal margin. I'm pleased with the players because they'll feel it and they'll understand it, I hope, and we'll move on to the next."

Le Bris laments Sunderland's consistency

Sunderland boss Regis Le Bris speaking with Sky Sports:

"Consistency is the key word in this league. We gave two opportunities from two unforced errors and it changed the game. After that, we had good spells and created good chances, but the consistency is not acceptable at this level.

"This is the reality of Sunderland this year and we have to manage it. I won't complain because of the schedule. We want to be in this position with many competitions to play.

"But at the same time, it is important to assume the reality and get better through consistency. I repeat, we were good in the Carabao Cup, good in the Europa League, but the Premier League is relentless.

"It's the best level in the world. At the moment, we are not consistent enough."

Analysis from Sky Sports' Callum Bishop:

"It would've been in the spirit of Halloween for the Black Cats to find a way to celebrate the day with a victory. However, their finishing was more of a horror show for Regis Le Bris.

"Enzo Le Fee's penalty was their first goal in the Premier League since they scored three against Manchester City on September 20. However, from open play, their struggles persist.

"They had more than double Coventry's xG this afternoon, albeit inflated by the spot-kick. Remove that from the equation and they still had slightly more than their opponents (0.80 vs 0.71).

"Ultimately, they just weren't anywhere near clinical enough when they got in to the areas to punish Coventry. Brian Brobbey looked like a shell of the hat-trick hero at the Etihad. Chemsdine Talbi also wasted a glorious chance.

"We have seen it so often where teams qualify for Europe and then struggle the following season. That is what Le Bris is faced with, but at least it is clear where the main problem lies."

Waldock gave Gills a third-minute lead, latching on to a low driven cross from McManus before converting from six yards.

Brook made an incredible save before the break, somehow clawing away Hale's effort from inside the box, before pulling off another excellent stop to deny McManus.

articles.summary: Fleetwood backed up their midweek Carabao Cup exploits with a 3-1 win over Bristol Rovers at Highbury.
articles.body:
Matt Lawlor's side, who knocked Premier League champions Arsenal out of the tournament on Tuesday night, picked up the three points thanks to goals from Aaron Loupalo-Bi, Rhys Bennett and Josh Roberston.

The Cod Army opened the scoring just after the half-hour mark through on-loan Fulham striker Loupalo-Bi when he finished neatly from just outside the area following some tidy work from Mark Helm.

The hosts then doubled their lead seven minutes into the second period thanks to a bullet header from centre-back Rhys Bennett when he got on the end of Harrison Neal's driven cross.

The visitors looked to have set up a nervy ending when Reiss Russell-Denny's looping cross floated over Jay Lynch and into the net at the far post to half the deficit heading into the last five minutes.

However, substitute Robertson sealed the win for the hosts minutes later when he coolly slotted home after being played in on goal by Will Davies.

Steve Evans' Bristol Rovers have now lost six of their last seven matches in all competitions and five consecutive away league games.

What the result means and next fixtures...

articles.title: Bournemouth 2-0 Leeds: Cherries punish James Trafford horror error to make it six wins on the spin
articles.summary: Report and free match highlights as brilliant Bournemouth make it six wins in a row without conceding in all competitions; James Trafford's horrendous error helped set the Cherries on their way
articles.body:
Marco Rose's side have now beaten Sturm Graz, Sunderland, AC Milan, Manchester United, Aston Villa and Leeds without conceding in an extraordinary run of results.

They were given a helping hand by Leeds goalkeeper James Trafford, whose Halloween horror show gifted Bournemouth the lead as Evanilson capitalised on a hapless pass out from the back.

The response from Leeds never came as they mustered just one shot on target from their 10 attempts on goal to a backdrop of a lowly 0.61 worth of expected goals. They have now scored just twice in their last five Premier League games.

The visitors had been the better team before falling behind but could not prevent their winless run stretching to five top-flight games. Leeds striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin was denied a goal on his 50th appearance for the club after his 11th-minute finish was ruled out for a handball spotted by VAR.

Bournemouth wrapped up the points in injury-time when Junior Eli Kroupi provided a wondrous assist, that included a nutmeg, to provide Amine Adli with the second goal.

Trafford's moment of madness costs Leeds dearly

Football can be a cruel game, especially for goalkeepers.

Leeds were the better side against Bournemouth up until the first goal. They had started brightly, looked comfortable and were asking questions of the Cherries. Then came the moment that changed everything.

Trafford's headloss in possession, gifting the ball straight to Justin Kluivert, was an invitation Bournemouth simply could not refuse. Leeds were then chasing a game they had been controlling.

The psychological damage was just as significant as the scoreboard. Leeds never really recovered, their confidence drained by a moment of self-inflicted punishment. Bournemouth had been handed the perfect platform and made sure they took full advantage.

Trafford has earned rave reviews since joining Leeds and there is plenty to admire about his potential. But this was a timely reminder that the England international is far from the finished article.

'Kroupi will be key for us, he's a difference maker'

"We conceded a goal, then lucky us [it was disallowed], from then we grew into the game. We won a high ball and scored an easy goal but it was hard work. It was an open game. It was a difficult game and a difficult opponent. I'm happy we solved the challenge.

"He [Junior Kroupi] could be a key factor for us this season. He's not yet 100 per cent fit but he understands the game and how he solves issues in tight situations. This is a guy who in the Premier League where you get space can make a difference. He worked hard today but he knows every metre to fill up his tank. He played 25 minutes today [Saturday] and we're going to increase his match time more and more."

Bournemouth have won three consecutive Premier League games without conceding for the very first time.

Evanilson registered his eighth Premier League goal involvement of the season (4 goals, 4 assists), with only Erling Haaland (9) having more; it's already more goal involvements than he managed in 36 appearances last term (6 goals, 1 assist).

Evanilson has now scored in four straight Premier League games, his longest such streak in the competition.

Evanilson is the first Brazilian player to score a Premier League goal on Halloween since Raphinha did so for Leeds United against Norwich City in 2021 - the only other Brazilians to do so are Ramires and Philippe Coutinho, both on Halloween 2015.

Justin Kluivert has assisted in back-to-back Premier League games, having not picked up a single assist in his previous 32 league outings - it's the first time he's had goal involvements in back-to-back league matches since March 2025 (v Brighton and Tottenham Hotspur).

articles.title: Leicester 2-2 Stevenage
articles.summary: Leicester 2-2 Stevenage
articles.body:
A clever strike from Tugra Turhan frustrated Leicester by earning Stevenage a 2-2 draw at the King Power Stadium.

The teenager, on loan from Istanbul Basaksehir, marked his league debut for the visitors by scoring the equaliser with 12 minutes remaining after combining with fellow substitute Chem Campbell.

Russell Martin's side had led twice but could not record a fourth win in five.

Despite making a fast start, when Sammy Braybrooke netted his first senior goal for the club after only 67 seconds when Stevenage failed to deal with a Luke Thomas cross, City handed their opponents a route back into the game.

Brittle defending has become a trademark for the hosts of late and the chain of events which allowed Ben Broggio to restore parity in the 22nd minute was every bit as calamitous as Stevenage's attempts to clear Thomas' cross.

After seeing Alex McCarthy spill the ball at Broggio's feet as he tried to gather Phoenix Patterson's centre, City regained the lead in the 66th minute when Tommy Setford turned Will Alves' shot into Kamari Doyle's path and the midfielder converted.

But Turhan pounced with an angled effort to deny the Foxes victory.
